One rule for both grades: a 200 ms excursion is admitted only from the continuous state or cold; above the continuous tier for more than 0.22 s the 200 ms limit equals the 2 min tier until 12 min of recovery (heatsink tau 179 s, 4.43 K excess, 0.10 K residual ASSUMED). The end-of-line test writes the grade's table into the controller's parameter set (CRC with the calibration), the controller reports it with the serial, the integrator records it; no record = grade B; a replaced device re-grades the module.
